About Me

The mind behind the ideas

I am a copywriter and creative communicator with three years of professional agency experience in a remote, part-time role, following a six-month internship.

My work spans Bangla and English copywriting, concept development, social media communication, scriptwriting and visual storytelling.

With a background in Mass Communication and Journalism from the University of Dhaka, I combine cultural observation, research and visual thinking to develop ideas that connect words with visuals.
